priorities.topic: U.S. AI Deregulation and Transit: What Lifting Restrictions on Anthropic's Most Powerful Models Means for Smart Transit Planning
priorities.angle: The NYT reports the U.S. has lifted export/use restrictions on Anthropic's most capable AI models. Examine how this deregulatory shift could accelerate AI-driven transit planning tools — demand forecasting, autonomous shuttle routing, equity audits — that previously relied on less capable model tiers.
